learning_task_started.purpose: Count deliberate starts of a learner task.

learning_task_finished.purpose: Measure successful completion against deliberate starts.

repair_completed.purpose: Measure completion of a correction or repair task without storing the answer.

returned_after_error.purpose: Measure whether a learner successfully returns after a recoverable error.

teacher_review_completed.purpose: Measure review turnaround without storing learner evidence.

metrics.task_finish_rate: Distinct finished task_id values divided by distinct started task_id values.
metrics.repair_completion_rate: Distinct repair_completed task_id values divided by started repair task_id values.
metrics.return_after_error_rate: returned_after_error events with recovery_action=completed divided by all returned_after_error events.
metrics.teacher_review_turnaround: Median teacher_review_completed.occurred_at minus review_ready_at, reported with P75 and sample size.
